headword: {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキン

definitions.explanation: An absorbent pad worn during menstruation to absorb menstrual flow. Sold in convenience stores and drug stores in Japan, often in separate daytime and nighttime varieties.

examples.japanese: {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキンをコンビニで{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I picked up some sanitary napkins at the convenience store.

examples.japanese: {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキンには{昼|ひる}{用|よう}と{夜|よる}{用|よう}がある。
examples.english: There are daytime and nighttime sanitary napkins.

examples.japanese: {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキンはトイレに{流|なが}さず、{専用|せんよう}の{袋|ふくろ}に{入|い}れてから{捨|す}ててください。
examples.english: Do not flush sanitary napkins down the toilet; please put them in a dedicated bag before disposing of them.

notes:
Combines {生理|せいり} (menstruation; physiology) and ナプキン (napkin). The abbreviated form {生理用品|せいりようひん} is also used to refer to menstrual products generally.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキンを{交換|こうかん}する: to change a pad
- {羽根|はね}つき{生理用|せいりよう}ナプキン: winged sanitary napkin
- ナイト{用|よう}{生理用|せいりよう}ナプキン: overnight sanitary napkin
